units.source_text: 《法华经》《常不轻菩萨品》曰：“我深敬汝等，不敢轻慢。

en.t: The Lotus Sutra, in the chapter on Bodhisattva Never Disparaging, says: "I deeply respect all of you and would never dare to look down on you.

units.source_text: 汝等皆行菩萨道，当得做佛。”

en.t: Because all of you are walking the bodhisattva path, and you shall become Buddhas."

units.source_text: 唱着这二十四字经文，向各处巡行，见人即拜，叫作“常不轻”礼拜。

en.t: Chanting this twenty-four-character passage, he traveled everywhere, bowing whenever he saw someone; this was called the worship of "Never Disparaging."
